content: Supabase free-tier projects auto-pause after 1 week of database inactivity; resuming takes ~30s and causes errors for users hitting it during that window. Free tier: 500MB DB, 1GB file storage, 5GB egress, 50k MAU, limit 2 active projects. Mitigate with a periodic keep-alive ping (e.g. via Vercel cron or GitHub Actions) or accept occasional cold starts.
